items.title: Prime Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Watch out! These horrors are breaking out from your technology and have a mind of their own! Block that sender, run your antivirus, and hope you don't get infected!

- Includes 12 digital prime glitch skins!
- When the sky goes dark and red lightning strikes can you survive?

items.title: Metallurgy Knights
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Sharpen your swords these knights are armed and armored! Which metal will you choose to protect yourself with? Will it be the slow but sturdy lead, the ancient and powerful bronze, or the flashy and lucky crown gold?

- Includes eighteen knight skins!
- Choose from six different metals to adorn your armor with!
- Three variants of each skin including hooded variants!

items.title: Teens! Angels vs Demons
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description: Our teens series is back, and this time it’s a battle between the sky and the earth! Are you a cute angel with wings and a halo? Or a cool demon kid with horns? PvP against your friends, or build your own celestial realm and underworld! The choice is yours with our latest skin pack!

items.title: Gamer Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Are you a gamer? Are you ready to look the part? Be a gamer teen with pride with this skin pack!

items.title: 80s Fashion Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Be a teen star in the 80s! Roleplay and get your disco groove on!

+ 10 groovy skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Power Suits 2.0
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Grab everyone's attention with these powerful looking skins! With bright colors hidden behind a dark shell, you will be impossible to miss!

- 8 unique skins
- With a variety of colors and patterns, pick the perfect one that suits you!

items.title: Gamer Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These gamer mobs are equipped with awesome new headsets, hoodies and awesome gamer merch! 

- 8 unique skins including Creeper, Skeleton, Enderman, Slime, and many more!
- Choose the perfect mob that suits your style!

items.title: Lucky Block Suits!
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These lucky blocks are wearing their new suits and are looking dapper! With different color lucky blocks, including the classic yellow, rainbow, and more, you will find it easy to find the skin that shows off your style!

- 8 fancy skins!
- Wide variety of suit designs and colors!

items.title: Lava Challenge
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Can you beat the game where every dirt block around you turns to lava? You can speedrun the Ender dragon, parkour to and from safety, or just sit around and watch the world burn. Regardless, there should hardly ever be a dull moment.

items.title: Rainbow Days
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Sunshine, rainbows and best friends! What could be better? Have fun playing together as one of these bright rainbow teens!

items.title: Techno Mechs
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Show your friends your mechanized might with these new techno mech skins! Show off with a shiny new paint job and kick tailpipe with these flashy new metal heroes!

items.title: Superhero Base
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Want to become a superhero? This modern mansion is the perfect place to begin; with an underground superhero base to explore!

+ Superhero cars and a helicopter
+ 4 HD superhero skins
+ Luxury modern mansion with placed furniture
+ Great for roleplay

items.title: Sky Reach
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: The sky is the limit with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Legend tells of a grand temple that trained the greatest masters of old. People travelled from distant lands in hopes of being taught to master the sky. But time masters all and the temple fell into shadow, its whereabouts lost. Now you've found it and it's up to you to rediscover its secrets!

items.title: Animal Masks
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These animal masks will make anyone look awesome!

+ Includes 10 animal mask skins
+ Great for roleplay

items.title: Dungeon
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
Escape from the island you were stranded on by clearing the mysterious dungeon!

+ 7 stages
+ With some PARKOUR!

Built by Team-KYO

items.title: Impostor Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Is there a lying devil among us? Could be, when you role-play with friends in interstellar Impostor Demons skins. Gear up in a colorful spacesuit with matching horns and see who you can fool. Join with crewmates and work to repair the spaceship in a most mischievous manner. Or maybe you are causing more damage?

+ 8 fake fiendish HD skins

items.title: Horror Clowns
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
These aren’t silly circus clowns! But with spooky clown makeup and wigs, you might scare Minecraft silly in Horror Clowns skins. Carrying knives instead of balloons, role-play with friends as frightening jesters looking to juggle humor and horror. Spread cheerful terror and funny fear everywhere you go. Who’s the bozo now?

+ 8 fearsome fool HD skins

items.title: SCP Armor
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
No one will be able to catch and hold you when you gear up in SCP Armor skins. In freaky and bizarre protective looks, role-play with friends as true Minecraft anomalies. Try this new style to defend yourself and scare everyone away with some paranormal plates of armor. Take advantage of your extra-dimensional status and perform impossible deeds.

+ 8 awful armor HD skins

items.title: Warship Empire - Battle Fleet
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Command the biggest warship in your armada. Explore huge battleships equipped with naval weapons. Role-play as the captain of a powerful fleet and set sail to conquer the Overworld. Use siege weapons to engage your opponents. Build your base on an island in the middle of the ocean.

3 new functional weapons: Ballista, Trebuchet, Cannon
6 warrior skins
Free skin included!

items.title: Anime Cats
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
What a cute kitty in fancy clothes! Choose from 12 adorable skins for some frisky role-play. Become a furry feline with big and beautiful anime cat eyes. Twitch your tail and whiskers as you explore the city. As a stray or purebred, meow and purr to your heart’s content.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Dream Jobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Workers keep the city moving! Pitch in and suit up when you role-play taking on the jobs that need to get done. Choose from 12 different skins that help this town move forward. Firefighter, police officer, chef, or doctor, dream big and land a hand!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Parkour Masters
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Run, climb, swing, roll, and jump when you role-play awesome parkour skills! Be a master at getting around the city in the most creative way. Choose from 8 expert skins that spark the imagination. As you travel from here to there, you’ll go around, across, through, over, and under.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Moon Demons
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Night falls, and the mysterious moon comes out. Half, full, or crescent, choose from 8 devilish skins. Play tricks while you role-play as demons in horns and sparkling star and moon gear. No time to feel sad, because you’ll be over the moon in no time!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Derp Life
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Make fashion that doesn’t mix or match the latest trend! With 12 silly skins to choose from, you’ll sport a very unique look, that’s for sure. Go about your daily life and role-play as a little goofy and foolish, in totally weird clothes. Get ready to stand out in any crowd!

1 free skin included!
